title: Choose the new look for Morning Brief
question: The roll assigned the Preflight Kneeboard. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Preflight Kneeboard
options.lineage: pilot kneeboard briefing cards and aeronautical charts
options.thesis: Your morning as a preflight briefing: one clipped card, read top to bottom, then you're cleared to go.
options.viewport: A clipped card: weather and date as a plain-words conditions strip, the headline as 'cleared for today', and your day drawn as a magenta route with a waypoint per meeting and a marker at now.
options.risk: Aviation codes could creep in and lose non-pilots; every label stays plain English, the chart grammar does the work.

raised.raise: State lives in line form: solid is now, dashed is upcoming, struck is done; never colour alone.
A folded tab marks where you stopped yesterday; everything after it is new.
One text size for body and labels; rank comes from weight and case, so the card reads calmly.

options.label: Tear-off Day Calendar
options.thesis: Each brief is today's page on a desk pad; opening it tears yesterday away.
options.viewport: A huge red day numeral and weekday, the headline beneath it, the pad's stacked page edges visible; yesterday's page tears off as you arrive.
options.risk: Familiar stationery skeuomorph; the giant numeral can feel like a gimmick by day five.

options.label: Build Instructions
options.thesis: The brief as a numbered build: each step is your next move, new pieces arrive bright, yesterday's sit ghosted.
options.viewport: Oversized step numerals down the page, each with a 1:1 call-out box of the app it came from; done items click flush.
options.case: Everyone recognises it and 'new versus already known' maps cleanly; loses on clarity because a brief is prose, not wordless steps.
options.risk: Toy-like; long paragraphs fight a wordless form.

options.label: Tabbed Reference Manual
options.thesis: The brief as an open manual: every section is a coloured divider tab sized by how much is in it.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail down the right edge shows the whole morning's shape; the open section's colour fills the board behind clear leaves.
options.case: Wins on clarity, the tab rail shows the morning's shape at a glance; loses on audience, boxed manuals are a fading memory.
options.risk: Its stepped, no-easing motion works against the smoothness you asked for.

options.label: Spectrogram Rail
options.thesis: Everything hangs off one rail; state is a line's height and dash.
options.viewport: One off-centre rail with sections as ticks.
options.case: Loses both axes: non-technical readers don't know spectrograms, and dark ash plates slow morning reading.
options.kept: State in line form, not hue.

options.label: Film Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Days as frames on a perforated rail; a tape flag where you stopped.
options.viewport: A perforated rail of past briefs across the top.
options.case: Loses both: few people know a cutting bench, and lateral scrubbing slows reading.
options.kept: A flag marks where you stopped.
options.risk: Heavy orange on black is loud for 8am.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.thesis: One type size; rank by weight, case and reversal.
options.case: Loses both: raked sideways travel hurts reading, and the reference is obscure.
options.kept: One text size; rank by weight and case.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Blocks of weather cut and stacked as sections.
options.viewport: Stacked cloud blocks with blue gaps.
options.case: Loses both: dreamlike, and it hides the task.
options.kept: Weather as material, not an icon.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean productivity app, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A tidy single-column brief with section cards and app icons, like a polished Notion or Linear page.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other AI summary tool by design.
